item.research_question: Can a high-throughput materials screening algorithm based on first-principles density functional theory and artificial neural network accurately predict the phase formation of PtPd-based high-entropy alloys?
key_findings: The algorithm exhibited high accuracy for all four prediction models on 36,556 data from 9139 HEA systems with 137,085 features.
The mean relative error (MRE) was within 5%.
The coefficient of determination (R2) was close to unity.
The number of FCC and BCC HEAs was 5002 and 4137, respectively.
The number of Exo HEAs was 4140 for FCC and 3567 for BCC phase.
item.mechanism: The combination of KKR-CPA and ANN can reduce the computational cost for the screening of PtPd-based HEA and accurately predict the structure.
item.limitations: The KKR-CPA method does not provide detail of atomic configuration, and the optimized lattice constant should be regarded as average lattice constant.
quotes: The algorithm exhibited high accuracy for all four prediction models on 36,556 data from 9139 HEA systems with 137,085 features.
The combination of KKR-CPA and ANN can reduce the computational cost for the screening of PtPd-based HEA and accurately predict the structure.
